sk_public_record_claim_tagging.name: Public Record Claim Tagging
sk_public_record_claim_tagging.definition: Tag every factual claim from a long primary document as SOLID (primary-doc backed), CONTESTED (plausible but split evidence), or OVERSTATED using IC/SAGO/peer-review cross-checks.
sk_public_record_claim_tagging.purpose: Separate documented institutional failures from advocacy conclusions in partisan or contested reports.

sk_lab_leak_epistemology.name: Lab Leak Epistemology
sk_lab_leak_epistemology.definition: Evaluate origin hypotheses (lab accident vs zoonosis) under public-record ceiling: weight IC low-confidence assessments, market geospatial evidence, genetic features (FCS, RBD), and absence of smoking-gun samples.
sk_lab_leak_epistemology.purpose: Avoid both premature conspiracy and premature dismissal; keep both hypotheses open until primary evidence closes them.

sk_grant_oversight_failure_audit.name: Grant Oversight Failure Audit
sk_grant_oversight_failure_audit.definition: Audit high-risk research grants (e.g. EcoHealth/WIV) for late progress reports, unreported experiments, sample location misrepresentation, and FOIA evasion culture.
sk_grant_oversight_failure_audit.purpose: Document process failures independently of whether the research caused a pandemic.

sk_policy_by_fiat_detection.name: Policy By Fiat Detection
sk_policy_by_fiat_detection.definition: Identify public-health rules (6-ft distancing, mask mandates, lockdowns) whose quantitative basis was weak or admitted to be ad-hoc ('sort of just appeared').
sk_policy_by_fiat_detection.purpose: Flag when authority claims science but testimony/FOIA show improvisation.

sk_agent_swarm_document_distill.name: Agent Swarm Document Distill
sk_agent_swarm_document_distill.definition: End-to-end: download long PDF → section extract → claim tag → Drive + GitHub push → live HTML dashboard under HITL public-record ceiling.
sk_agent_swarm_document_distill.purpose: Operational multi-agent pipeline for 500+ page oversight reports.

sk_latent_vector_space_ingest.name: Latent Vector Space Ingest
sk_latent_vector_space_ingest.definition: Map investigation objects (Document, Chunk, Entity, Claim, Hypothesis, Agent, Modifier, Artifact) into a claim-grain latent space with decision axes: epistemic tag, hypothesis support, source quality, conflict-of-interest. Forbid single-vector pooling of long reports.
sk_latent_vector_space_ingest.purpose: Preserve rare identifiers and separate process failure from origin inference using geometry over rhetoric.

sk_system_level_modifier_validation.name: System Level Modifier Validation
sk_system_level_modifier_validation.definition: Register named modifiers M1–M6 (public-record ceiling, HITL, dual-anti-narrative, tag discipline, process≠origin, category-error watch) and validate each with a pass/fail test against both narrative tribes.
sk_system_level_modifier_validation.purpose: Prevent prompt vibes and inverse-dogma from replacing reproducible gates.

sk_atomized_artifact_output.name: Atomized Artifact Output
sk_atomized_artifact_output.definition: Emit versioned ClaimAtoms, SkillAtoms, agent reports, ACH posteriors, HTML dashboards, and GitHub/Drive hashes. Chat is index; artifacts are product.
sk_atomized_artifact_output.purpose: Make investigation results citable, reloadable, and session-surviving.

sk_educator_macro_micro_template.name: Educator Macro Micro Template
sk_educator_macro_micro_template.definition: Mandatory step template: Phase, Step Title, Why, Theory, Nested Execution, Tools, Pitfalls+Fixes, KPI, and contrast table vs opposite approach.
sk_educator_macro_micro_template.purpose: Block summarization skips and unfalsifiable depth; force measurable completion before next step.

sk_lvs_slmvp_aao_pipeline.name: Lvs Slmvp Aao Pipeline
sk_lvs_slmvp_aao_pipeline.definition: End-to-end permanent operating pipeline: Latent Vector Space placement → System-Level Modifier Validation → Atomized Artifact Output under dual-anti-narrative and HITL.
sk_lvs_slmvp_aao_pipeline.purpose: Single default procedure for every swarm investigation and educator deep-dive.

sk_educator_macro_micro_guide.name: Educator Macro Micro Guide
sk_educator_macro_micro_guide.definition: Mandatory pedagogical wrapper: for every step emit Phase Header, Step Title, Why, Granular Execution Plan, Tools/Resources, Common Pitfalls & Fixes (2–3), and KPI before next step. High operational volume without blending points.
sk_educator_macro_micro_guide.purpose: Prevent summarizing away gates; force falsifiable completion criteria on deep-dives.
